Rule claude.rules for ancestors: launched in packages/api, the rules in .claude/rules/ of the repository root and of packages/ (an ancestor that is not the git root) load like the launch directory's own, the one without `paths` at launch and the one with `paths` on read of a matching file (Agent SDK features page: "`.claude/rules/*.md` in every parent directory"). ctxreach predicts them only with the resolver's ancestorRules option for now; without it they are listed as not modelled.
